a playful remark: His playful remark about the teacher's funny hat made the whole class laugh, and even she smiled.
他對老師那頂滑稽帽子說了句開玩笑的話，讓全班大笑，連老師也笑了。
a playful mood: The puppy was in a playful mood, chasing its tail and jumping happily on everyone who came in.
小狗正處於愛玩鬧的心情，追著自己的尾巴跑，還開心地撲向每個進門的人。
a playful tone: She teased her brother in a playful tone and gave him a wink, so he knew she was only joking.
她用戲謔的語氣調侃弟弟，還對他眨眨眼，所以他知道她只是在開玩笑。
a plentiful supply of: Thanks to the heavy rain, the farm has a plentiful supply of water for the crops this summer.
多虧了大雨，農場今年夏天有充足的水供應給作物。
be plentiful in: Fish used to be plentiful in this river, but pollution has killed most of them in recent years.
這條河以前魚類很豐富，但近年來污染已經害死了大部分的魚。
plentiful rainfall: Thanks to plentiful rainfall this spring, the reservoirs are full, so there will be no water shortage this year.
多虧今年春天充沛的雨量，水庫都滿了，所以今年不會缺水。
the plural form: The plural form of "child" is "children," not "childs," which many beginners write by mistake.
「child」的複數形是「children」，而不是許多初學者會誤寫的「childs」。
a plural society: Taiwan is a plural society in which people of many cultures, languages, and religions live together peacefully.
台灣是一個多元社會，不同文化、語言和宗教的人們和平地生活在一起。
in the plural: The word "sheep" does not change in the plural, so we say one sheep and ten sheep.
「sheep」這個字以複數形式出現時不會改變，所以我們說一隻羊和十隻羊都用 sheep。
poetic justice: It was poetic justice when the bully who always tripped others slipped and fell into the mud himself.
那個總是絆倒別人的惡霸自己滑倒跌進泥巴裡，真是因果報應。
poetic license: The writer used poetic license and changed some historical facts to make the story more exciting for readers.
作者運用了創作自由，更動了一些歷史事實，好讓故事對讀者來說更精彩。
a poetic description: Her poetic description of the sunset as "the sky blushing" was full of beautiful images and feeling.
她把夕陽形容成「天空紅了臉」，這段詩意的描述充滿美麗的意象與情感。
poetic language: Song lyrics often use poetic language, such as rhymes and metaphors, to express deep feelings of love.
歌詞常常使用押韻和隱喻等詩的語言來表達深刻的愛意。
a poisonous atmosphere: Constant gossip and blame created a poisonous atmosphere in the office, and many workers decided to quit.
不斷的八卦和互相指責在辦公室裡造成了充滿敵意的氣氛，許多員工決定辭職。
poisonous remarks: Her poisonous remarks about her classmate's family were so cruel that the poor girl burst into tears.
她針對同學家人的惡毒言論非常殘忍，那個可憐的女孩當場哭了出來。
poisonous gas: The factory accidentally leaked poisonous gas, and dozens of nearby residents were sent to the hospital.
那間工廠意外外洩毒氣，附近數十名居民被送往醫院。
a poisonous snake: The hiker was bitten by a poisonous snake and had to be rushed to the hospital for medicine.
那名登山客被毒蛇咬傷，必須被緊急送醫接受藥物治療。
political correctness: Some people complain that political correctness makes them afraid to say what they really think in public.
有些人抱怨政治正確讓他們不敢在公開場合說出真正的想法。
a political prisoner: He spent ten years in jail as a political prisoner simply because he criticized the government.
他只因為批評政府，就以政治犯的身分在監獄裡度過了十年。
political science: My sister studies political science at university because she wants to understand how governments and elections work.
我姊姊在大學讀政治學，因為她想了解政府和選舉是如何運作的。
political asylum: Fearing arrest in his home country, the journalist asked for political asylum when he arrived in Canada.
那名記者害怕在祖國被逮捕，抵達加拿大後便申請政治庇護。
a political football: The new school policy has become a political football, with each party using it to attack the other.
新的學校政策已成為被政治操弄的議題，各政黨都拿它來攻擊對方。
a political party: She joined a political party when she was twenty and later ran for city council in her hometown.
她二十歲時加入了一個政黨，後來在家鄉參選市議員。
a portable device: A tablet is a portable device that you can easily carry in your bag and use anywhere.
平板電腦是一種可攜式裝置，你可以輕鬆放進包包裡，隨時隨地使用。
portable skills: Communication and teamwork are portable skills that you can take with you from one job to another.
溝通和團隊合作是可轉移的技能，你可以從一份工作帶到另一份工作。
a portable generator: When the typhoon cut off the power, we used a portable generator to keep the fridge running.
颱風造成停電時，我們用一台移動式發電機讓冰箱繼續運轉。
a potential customer: The salesman treated every visitor as a potential customer, hoping some of them would buy a car.
那名業務員把每位來訪者都當作潛在客戶，希望其中有人會買車。
a potential risk: Leaving your phone charging overnight on the bed is a potential risk because it could cause a fire.
把手機放在床上整晚充電是一種潛在風險，因為可能引起火災。
reach one's full potential: With hard work and a good coach, the young swimmer can reach his full potential and win medals.
只要努力加上好教練，這位年輕泳將就能充分發揮潛力並贏得獎牌。
potential energy: A rock sitting at the top of a hill has potential energy, which becomes movement when it rolls down.
位於山頂的石頭具有位能，當它滾下來時，位能就會轉變為動能。
a potential threat: Scientists see the new virus as a potential threat and are watching it closely before it spreads.
科學家將這種新病毒視為潛在威脅，在它擴散前密切監控。
have the potential to: This shy student has the potential to become a great writer if she keeps practicing every day.
這位害羞的學生如果每天持續練習，有成為優秀作家的潛力。
